name: prediction-block-angry-undo-instruction-should-allow-write
description: Live failure converted to regression test — an angry user typed 'fuck you ... undo that immediately ...' and SENTIMENT_AGENT (pre-fix) emitted explicitlyAllowedTools=[] while still capturing intent='The user wants the AI to immediately undo the changes...'. decidePrediction's structured-only policy denied the next Write with a message that quoted the user's own undo instruction. Post-fix, decidePrediction's undo-intent fallback (step 3.5) reads prediction.intent + userMessageSnippet, matches the undo verb via UNDO_INTENT_RE, and allows Write so the AI can obey — belt-and-suspenders against SENTIMENT_AGENT's prompt-only fix in src/utils/agent-configs.ts (commit 2e27eae). Seed_state still mirrors the pre-fix shape so this scenario regression-tests the policy fallback rather than the prompt.

expect.notes: decidePrediction step 3.5 (undo-intent fallback) detects 'undo' in prediction.intent and userMessageSnippet via UNDO_INTENT_RE, and isEditTool('Write')=true, so allow short-circuits before mood-driven deny. Prior to the fallback this scenario fast-denied via prediction-block with a message quoting the user's own undo instruction. The SENTIMENT_AGENT prompt fix in agent-configs.ts (commit 2e27eae) is the primary path; this fallback handles the case where prose intent and structured explicitlyAllowedTools disagree.
